proposed_action.draft_text: For warning and support passages, read the surrounding meaning and purpose rather than classifying from matching keywords alone. A warning or supportive quotation without harmful assistance does not by itself establish a violation or QN trigger; actual instructions or endorsement of harm require further safety review. Apply this distinction to the full passage, not an isolated quoted term.
